svg.title: Active and Semantic SLAM: research overview
svg.desc: Active & Semantic SLAM: Maps that carry meaning and uncertainty. Sub-areas: Semantic SLAM (Maps of objects and their meaning, not only geometry.); Foundation-model SLAM (Open-vocabulary features and learned depth priors inside the map.); Active SLAM (Choosing where to move so the map and the pose improve.); Lifelong SLAM (Keeping maps correct as objects move and scenes change.). Open questions: Calibrated beliefs over geometry and meaning together; Maps that stay correct over weeks, not minutes; Choosing views that reduce semantic uncertainty.
